text: Network analysis has been extensively used to study posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD), but only a few studies have examined the network structure of ICD-11 complex PTSD (CPTSD). Currently, no networks of all CPTSD symptoms have been estimated on military samples. Therefore, this study aims to (1) explore the connections of CPTSD symptoms and (2) identify the most central symptoms in a clinical sample of military veterans presenting with CPTSD symptomatology.
source_label: A network analysis of ICD-11 complex posttraumatic stress disorder symptoms in Danish treatment-seeking military veterans
